name: live-qa-validator-incognito
description: Live QA intake panel using the standard MCP Apps client. Isolated Chrome DevTools context target flow (incognito-equivalent clean state) with an optional multi-select BrowserStack real-device pass. Acceptance criteria and one or more Target URLs (multi-line) are free-text intake fields. Requires positive/negative test-case pairing, a matrix approval gate before execution, rigorous Figma-vs-live UI comparison, and annotated screenshot-comparison images for every UI defect.
